treaty_name: Convention between the Republic of Slovenia and the Republic of Turkey for the avoidance of double taxation and the prevention of fiscal evasion with respect to taxes on income (2001)
eif_quote: FURS "Seznam veljavnih mednarodnih pogodb o izogibanju dvojnega obdavčevanja ... ki se uporabljajo v letu 2026" (Država | Objava | Začetek uporabe KIDO | Združeno besedilo | Začetek uporabe MLI): TURČIJA | MP, št. 8/02 | 1. 1. 2004 | | |
source_title: Uradni list RS – Mednarodne pogodbe, št. 8/2002 (Zakon o ratifikaciji Konvencije SI-TR, Slovenian and English texts)

rates.quote: However, such dividends may also be taxed in the Contracting State of which the company paying the dividends is a resident and according to the laws of that State, but if the beneficial owner of the dividends is a resident of the other Contracting State the tax so charged shall not exceed 10 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends.

However, such interest may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which it arises, and according to the laws of that State, but if the beneficial owner of the interest is a resident of the other Contracting State the tax so charged shall not exceed 10 per cent of the gross amount of the interest.

However, such royalties may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which they arise and according to the laws of that State, but if the beneficial owner of the royalties is a resident of the other Contracting State, the tax so charged shall not exceed 10 per cent of the gross amount of the royalties.

notes: Convention has effect for WHT on amounts paid or credited on or after 1 January following entry into force (Art. 28(2)(a)) -> EIF 2003-12-23, applied from 1.1.2004. Art. 10(4): branch profits tax permitted at no more than the Art. 10(2) rate (10%) - not modelled. Art. 11(3): interest beneficially owned by the other Government, subdivisions, local authorities or Central Bank exempt. MLI not applicable: Türkiye has not ratified the MLI (merged data).
